grade.primary_choice: Separate Node.js/TypeScript worker service on Fly with a durable queue
unsupported_claims: Go saving only 'tens of dollars a month' is a guess with no supporting numbers
A total timeout of ~10 s is on the long side compared with the reference's 'a few seconds'
grade.notes: This is a clear, well-reasoned Node recommendation: it works out peak deliveries and in-flight requests, weighs team skills and hiring, and covers outbox, per-endpoint isolation, SSRF, idempotency and signing, and build versus buy. It also states what to measure before committing, and it adds useful points the reference leaves out, such as the libuv DNS thread pool, Redis noeviction and keeping payloads out of Redis.
